text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: You didn't sleep well last night, did you?
You couldn't sleep well last night?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I read that popular manga. It 
turned out to be... pretty scary...
choice_data_list: 昨日はよく眠れなかったのか？
昨日はよく眠れなかったの？
choice_data_list_en: Did you have trouble sleeping last night?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No way! As if! I-I'm not scared of 
ghosts in the slightest!!
choice_data_list: 怖くて寝つけなくなっちゃったとか……？
choice_data_list_en: Could it be you were too scared to sleep...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Why am I sleep-deprived...? Right, because 
I binge-read the whole thing! Man, it was 
so good! Wahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless of the reason, Shinko Windy 
doesn't seem to have gotten much rest due 
to a lack of sleep...
